name: Autistic Girls Network
description: UK neurodivergent-led charity offering information, community activity, education and support focused on autistic and neurodivergent girls, women and gender-diverse people.
intended_use: Find a specialist lived-experience-led route focused on people whose autism may present or be recognised differently from traditional stereotypes.
audience_or_context: Autistic and neurodivergent girls, women and gender-diverse people, families, educators, professionals and employers.
limitations: The organisation focuses on a particular population and perspective; its resources do not establish that any individual is autistic.
Some services, groups or educational offers may have age, geography, referral, capacity or funding limits.
cost_or_access_notes: The website provides free information; specific programmes, training, school placements or events can have separate access or funding arrangements.
conflicts_of_interest: The charity campaigns for changes in recognition and support of autistic girls, women and gender-diverse people; ND Oracle lists that perspective rather than treating it as neutral diagnostic authority.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
